shard.title: battery: Sense of belonging at school
shard.basis: members of group 2012.belonging (origin publisher) in the current release (2012, 2015, 2018, 2022)

name: ST87Q01
label: Sense of Belonging - Feel Like Outsider

questions.text: Thinking about your school: to what extent do you agree with the following statements? I feel like an outsider (or left out of things) at school.
questions.stem: Thinking about your school: to what extent do you agree with the following statements?
questions.item: I feel like an outsider (or left out of things) at school.
questions.instructions: (Please darken only one circle in each row.)
questions.note: The US version (NCES), adapted from the international questionnaire; the OECD's international version isn't a source here. The forms print the international id ST87 above the question, numbered Q40a on form B, Q54a on form C.
